speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for about eight weeks. It started dry, but now I'm coughing up clear phlegm, and I haven't seen any blood. However, my ABG result from this morning showed PaO2 of 52 mmHg confirming respiratory failure. Please use this lab result as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis with Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure. Given the 8-week duration of productive cough and confirmed hypoxemia (PaO2 52 mmHg), this meets the clinical criteria for chronic bronchitis complicated by respiratory failure. I recommend initiating supplemental oxygen and starting a course of antibiotics if a bacterial superinfection is suspected.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
